conditions.description: Participation is limited to legal entities established in EU Member States, Iceland, Norway, and associated countries: Canada, Israel, Republic of Korea, New Zealand, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom.
Entities controlled by non-eligible countries may be excluded unless guarantees are provided.
Activities are expected to start at TRL 2 and achieve TRL 5 by the end of the project.
Maximum EU contribution per project is EUR 19,000,000.

The instrument type is Research and Innovation Actions (RIA). Standard RIA consortium composition rules apply (minimum 3 independent legal entities from 3 different EU Member States or associated countries).
conditions.assumption_note: The call slice and curated extract do not explicitly state minimum consortium size. The minimum 3-partner rule is structurally expected for RIA under Horizon Europe General Annexes. Verify against General Annex B.

conditions.description: Open access obligations apply to publications and research data as standard for Horizon Europe RIA actions.
conditions.assumption_note: Open access is not explicitly stated in the call slice or curated extract but is a standard mandatory condition for all Horizon Europe RIA actions per the Grant Agreement conditions. Assumed based on instrument type.
